text:
Marina: Hey team — PR #3421 adds an "availability matrix" table for regional support (localization + data residency notes). I spotted a mismatch for embeddings: the matrix lists EU as supported, but the SDK sample in the same PR uses `eu-west-1`. Can infra confirm which EU region is actually live for embeddings? :eyes:
Sam K: I can confirm embeddings are live in eu-west-2 (London). eu-west-1 is NOT enabled for embeddings yet — that's a backlog task.
Marina: Thanks @Sam K. Okay, we should either update the matrix to call out eu-west-2 specifically or mark EU as partial and list region-level differences. Which do you prefer?
Leo (infra): Opening an infra ticket now to track enabling eu-west-1 (if needed). ETA for investigation: EOD tomorrow. For the docs side, mark EU as "partial" and list region-level endpoints until infra confirms parity.
Priya (devex): I'll update the SDK snippets in the PR to use eu-west-2 and add a short note about region-specific availability. Suggestion for the note: "Embeddings are currently available in: eu-west-2 (London). Other EU regions may be added; check the matrix for details." Also will add an inline code sample for setting the region header, since a few customers rely on that.
Marina: Yes, please add the header example. The current snippet shows `Region: eu-west-1` inline which is misleading.
Priya (devex): Pushed a small change to the branch with the updated Python + JS examples. Python example: 
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=MY_KEY, region="eu-west-2")
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="embed-lite", input="hello")
print(resp)
```
And a short note snippet for HTTP header: 
```http
POST /v1/embeddings
Host: api.redwood.ai
X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-2
Authorization: Bearer $KEY
```
Sam K: That looks good. We'll try to accelerate eu-west-1 enablement, but docs should reflect current state.
Angela: From a compliance/legal POV, please add a single-sentence data residency flag near the matrix: "Data residency location reflects where inference occurs; customers with strict residency needs should contact sales for dedicated/private deployments." Keep it short.
Marina: Good call, @Angela — I'll add that line and a link to the residency guide.
Priya (devex): Also found some old link targets in the PR pointing to `/docs/regions` instead of the new `/docs/geo`. Updated those to avoid 404s.
deploy-bot: staging deploy for branch docs/pr-3421 started — build 8842.
Leo (infra): FYI build 8842 hit a doc linter warning about the table width, PR updated to wrap columns.
Marina: Final checklist before I merge: 1) mark EU as "partial (eu-west-2 only)" in the matrix, 2) update SDK snippets to eu-west-2, 3) add residency one-liner and link to guide, 4) fix link targets to /docs/geo, 5) merge when staging deploy passes and infra confirms ticket or we file follow-up.
Sam K: I'll update the infra ticket with the docs changes and post back.
Marina: Thanks all — assigning reviewers @Priya (devex) and @Sam K. If deploy passes and no objections by EOD, I'll merge and we can follow up for region parity separately. :thumbsup:
